description: This Java class 'GatewayCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider' provides a gateway service for signal-enriching facades with caching capabilities using an asynchronous Caffeine cache. It manages the creation and provisioning of SignalEnrichmentFacade instances with caching, based on configuration and actor system context.

classes.name: GatewayCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: A provider class that supplies cache-enabled SignalEnrichmentFacade instances for gateway services, using an async cache and actor system.

methods.name: GatewayCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the caching facade using actor system and configuration.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Returns the cached SignalEnrichmentFacade for a given HTTP request.
